name: _help
Vivekananda Sarovar (Budha Talaab)
summary: The city's oldest lake, with an island garden and a 37 ft statue of Swami Vivekananda.

name: Mahant Ghasidas Memorial Museum
summary: Idols, ancient inscriptions, rare coins and archaeological finds from the region, opposite the Collectorate office.

name: Nandanvan Jungle Safari
summary: A large safari park in Sector 39 with herbivore, bear, tiger and lion zones, beside the Khandwa reservoir.

name: Purkhauti Muktangan
summary: A garden with life-like tribal figures and folk-art displays that introduce Chhattisgarh's culture.

name: Dudhadhari Temple
summary: A 17th-century Vaishnav temple known for sculptures that tell scenes from the Ramayana.

name: Hatkeshwar Mahadev Temple
summary: A Shiva temple on the Kharun river, about 5 km from the city, built in 1402 in the Kalchuri period.

name: Kankali Talab
summary: A pond with a Shiva temple at its centre, a large banyan tree and the samadhis of sages.

name: Town Hall (Victoria Jubilee Hall)
summary: A historic hall built between 1887 and 1889, near Shastri Chowk and the Collectorate.

name: Solar Energy Park
summary: An energy-education park about 7 km from the city, with exhibits, working models and solar-powered cars and boats.

name: Nagar Ghadi (Ghadi Chowk)
summary: The renovated clock pillar near Shastri Chowk, a landmark of the old city.

name: Sirpur
summary: Ancient capital of the Somavanshi dynasty, known for the brick Lakshman temple that Queen Vasata built.

name: Rajim
summary: A temple town at a river confluence, often called the Prayag of Chhattisgarh. Travel time and best season to be added.

name: Barnawapara Wildlife Sanctuary
summary: A forest sanctuary for a day or weekend of wildlife spotting. Entry rules, timings and safari details to be added.

name: Gol Bazaar
summary: A well-known central market area. We are collecting what to buy here and the best time to go.

name: Sadar Bazaar
summary: A busy central market area. Details on what it is best for are being collected.

name: Pandri Market
summary: A large market area near the old bus stand. Details on what it is best for are being collected.

name: Chila
summary: A savoury pancake made from rice-flour batter, a classic Chhattisgarhi breakfast usually eaten with chutney.

name: Farra
summary: Rice-flour dumplings, typically steamed and then tempered with spices.

name: Muthiya
summary: Steamed rice-flour dumplings, a homestyle Chhattisgarhi snack.

name: Dehrori
summary: A traditional Chhattisgarhi sweet made from rice and sugar syrup.

name: AIIMS Raipur
summary: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, a medical college and teaching hospital.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Memorial Hospital
summary: A large government hospital in the city, linked to the Pt. J.N.M. Medical College.

name: Dau Kalyan Singh Hospital
summary: A hospital near Shastri Chowk, close to the Town Hall.

name: Rajkumar College
summary: A historic boarding school founded in 1882 and moved to Raipur in 1894, known for its gardens, arches and architecture.

name: NIT Raipur
summary: National Institute of Technology, Raipur.

name: IIM Raipur
summary: Indian Institute of Management, Raipur.

name: IIIT Naya Raipur
summary: Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee International Institute of Information Technology, Naya Raipur.

name: Pt. Ravishankar Shukla University
summary: A state university with many departments and affiliated colleges.

name: Hidayatullah National Law University
summary: A national law university in Naya Raipur.
